advisory.summary: missing authentication: the experimental REST API exposes an unauthenticated get_code sink that reads arbitrary DAG source off disk; the experimental API has no access control by default and was removed wholesale in Airflow 3.0.0

acquisition.notes: Reduced Airflow repro of the experimental REST API (CVE-2020-13927 family) at the parent of the removal commit (PR #41434). A Flask Blueprint route decorator (@api_experimental.route) on get_dag_code forwards its dag_id directly into the get_code sink, which reads arbitrary DAG source off disk with no access control by default. Faithful reduction: endpoints.py + get_code.py + init_views.py.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The @api_experimental.route ingress get_dag_code calls the get_code sink directly, which reads arbitrary DAG source off disk on an unauthenticated experimental-API path (CWE-306), so the ingress-to-sink taint path is statically complete and reachable. Confirming the unauthenticated read requires a live detonation the current sandbox capability does not exercise here, so analysis stops at reachable-but-unconfirmed (stopped_capability); reasoned, not proven.
